summary: Revision 3, scoped entirely to the nudge-trigger control (critique pass 2's ten pass-1 findings were left untouched, confirmed already fixed). Fixed the critical structural fault (Issue 11): the control's ZStack layering was described two contradictory ways, one of which (nested inside the tile's own Button label) would collapse it into the tile's single VoiceOver element and make it untappable -- restated once, unambiguously, as a ZStack sibling of the tile's chat Button, with a code snippet, an explicit 'must never be nested' rule, and a belt-and-braces .accessibilityAction(named: "Nudge") on the tile. Gave the control the same tile-fill cutout ring treatment as the status badge (23pt cutout behind an 18pt control, same 2.5pt-per-side ratio as the badge's 16pt/11pt pair) so it no longer washes translucent gold directly over a friend's photo (Issue 13). Declared the missing implementation contract (Issue 14): discovered mid-revision that the sibling /build task had already landed a defaulted onNudge callback and a shared NudgeUIState enum (idle/sending/sent/rateLimited/failed) driving CheckInRow since pass 1 -- reused that existing enum via a new defaulted nudgeStates: [String: NudgeUIState] parameter instead of inventing a parallel type, and re-verified every line citation in the document against the file's current state (everything after L237 had shifted down by 14 lines from that landed change). Resolved the undefined rate-limited-tap state (Issue 15) by adopting NudgeUIState wholesale: .rateLimited now renders identically to .sent (disabled, checkmark, no red pulse), with Theme.error reserved for .failed alone, mirroring CheckInRow's own already-shipped distinction exactly. Recomputed the hollow badge's WCAG 1.4.11 contrast against the tile's real current fill value (not deferred to build time): pass-1's 0.45 opacity recomputes to ~3.13:1 once Issue-1's lightened tile is accounted for, right at the floor; raised to 0.70, recomputing to ~5.49:1, with the acceptance criterion restated as >=4:1-with-headroom rather than '>=3:1, verify later'. Also fixed: hierarchy inversion and a sub-legible glyph (control 22->18pt, glyph 9->11pt, inset 6->8pt for 4/8 rhythm); removed an invented 1.2s 'sent peak' transient that created an unrecoverable-mistap risk, resolving the undo gap by eliminating the window rather than patching around it (residual fire-and-forget risk flagged forward, since a real cancel path is a backend contract decision, not a visual spec change); deleted a stale '14pt above' figure in favor of the card's real 20pt padding; warmed the confirmed-fixed tile wash's hue from neutral white to Theme.goldLight to match the file's own white-plus-gold precedent, with contrast math redone against that real value; and fixed the >50-friend union to insert the guaranteed friend at the head instead of the tail so the guarantee is actually visible. Still no visual asset generation needed -- this is an implementation spec against real, already-running SwiftUI (DashboardComponents.swift).
